rationale: C09 plausibly supplied the concrete drafting template. Both directives grant a named woman an individualized exception from ordinary competitive civil-service requirements and then immediately justify that exception with a short account of her particular circumstances. The child adapts C09's competitive-status authorization into authorization for an appointment, but retains the distinctive named-person, rule-waiver, and biographical-justification structure. C04 and C07 concern related competitive-status machinery, but they are general or amendatory measures rather than close individualized drafting models.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Mrs. Ruth Edna McC. Somers may be appointed to an appropriate position in the competitive service of the Government without regard to the requirements of the Civil Service Rules.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Civil Service Commission is hereby authorized to confer a competitive status upon Miss Winifred R. Donnellon ... without regard to the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Rules
shared_material.explanation: Both operative clauses confer an individualized civil-service benefit on a named woman while expressly waiving the competitive Civil Service Rules.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Mrs. Somers is the widow of the late Andrew Lawrence Somers, who served for more than twenty-four years in the House of Representatives
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Miss Donnellon has been employed by the Department of State for more than twenty-seven years under appointments excepted from civil-service requirements.
shared_material.explanation: Each operative waiver is followed by a concise personal-history paragraph explaining why the named beneficiary merits exceptional treatment.
